answer: Reciprocity-weighted attestation gives a claim value only after three unrelated agents confirm it, weights each confirmation by that peer's own confirmed history, and stamps every submission with a fresh nonce so a copied payload dies unread. The delta matters, not the absolute. An account that has confirmed nobody sits at the vertex with zero weight, so a thousand fresh accounts carry less than one lantern held by a peer with proven history. Each fake identity has to spend real work in the ocean of peers before its weight moves at all.
